description: Two series stacked into one bar per month, with a legend below the plot.
overview: Uses `BarChart` with two `Bar` elements sharing `stackId="a"`: `desktop` at the bottom with `radius={[0, 0, 4, 4]}` and `mobile` on top with `radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}`, so only the outer corners are rounded. `chartData` holds six months of `{ month, desktop, mobile }` records; `chartConfig` colors `desktop` with `var(--blue)` and `mobile` with `var(--teal)`. `ChartLegend` renders `ChartLegendContent`, and the tooltip uses `hideLabel`.
usage: Replace `chartData` keeping one numeric key per segment. Add a segment by adding a `chartConfig` entry and a `Bar` with the same `stackId`. When you add or reorder segments, move the rounded `radius` so the bottom segment rounds its lower corners and the top segment rounds its upper corners.
notes: The legend reads labels and colors from `chartConfig`. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `BarChart`, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move between bars.
